coverage_note: This index enumerates high-value management endpoint families in full (key, model, team, user, budget, spend, customer, organization, health, cache, guardrails, policies, config, sso, callbacks, tag, access_groups, prompts, scim, compliance, audit, tools, agents, vector_store, workflow, project, jwt, claude-code, public, utils, router/fallback, email, ui, langfuse, adaptive_router, usage). 314 of 544 management routes are enumerated here. The remainder are provider pass-through endpoints (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Vertex, Bedrock, Cohere, Mistral, VLLM, Milvus, Cursor, AssemblyAI, Google AI Studio — each 5-10 routes) and are available in full in openapi_route_inventory.json. requires_db is inferred from path semantics (marked '(inferred from path)') and reflects whether the endpoint mutates/queries DB-backed entities (virtual keys, teams, users, budgets, spend). The workestrate runs in-memory with no Postgres, so requires_db=true endpoints are unavailable.

requires_db_legend.true: Path mutates/queries DB-backed entities (keys, teams, users, budgets, spend, agents registry, scim, prompts, tags, policies, etc.). Unavailable in workestrate in-memory deployment.
requires_db_legend.false: Path reads static config or operates without DB (health, cache, callbacks/list, public, utils, router settings, compliance checks, langfuse passthrough).
